```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)


#-------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load Data
#-------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv("data/aspatial/HDBresale.csv")

# Ensure month is parsed
df <- df %>%
  mutate(month = ym(month))
```
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#-------------------------------------------------
# 2. Filter training data (Jul 2024 – Jun 2025)
#-------------------------------------------------
train_df <- df %>%
  filter(month >= ym("2024-07") & month <= ym("2025-06")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(resale_price))  # ensure no missing price
```
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#-------------------------------------------------
# 3. Minimal cleaning (robust — no assumptions about LAT/LONG)
#-------------------------------------------------
train_df <- train_df %>%
  mutate(
    town = factor(town),
    flat_type = factor(flat_type),
    flat_model = factor(flat_model),
    floor_area_sqm = as.numeric(floor_area_sqm),
    # extract lower range of 'storey_range', e.g., "05 TO 08" → 5
    storey_start = as.numeric(str_extract(storey_range, "^\\d+")),
    lease_years_left = 99 - (year(month) - year(lease_commence_date))
  )

# Keep only columns that always exist in HDB resale data
model_df <- train_df %>% select(
  resale_price,
  town, flat_type, floor_area_sqm,
  storey_start, lease_years_left, flat_model
)
```
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#-------------------------------------------------
# 4. Train/test split
#-------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(model_df$resale_price, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train <- model_df[trainIndex,]
test  <- model_df[-trainIndex,]
```
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#-------------------------------------------------
# 5. Random Forest Model
#-------------------------------------------------
rf_model <- randomForest(
  resale_price ~ .,
  data = train,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

print(rf_model)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
#-------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create prediction dataset (Jul–Sep 2025)
#    We re-use actual rows but update month
#-------------------------------------------------
future_df <- df %>%
  filter(month >= ym("2025-07") & month <= ym("2025-09")) %>%
  mutate(
    town = factor(town, levels = levels(model_df$town)),
    flat_type = factor(flat_type, levels = levels(model_df$flat_type)),
    flat_model = factor(flat_model, levels = levels(model_df$flat_model)),
    storey_start = as.numeric(str_extract(storey_range, "^\\d+")),
    lease_years_left = 99 - (year(month) - year(lease_commence_date))
  )

# If there is no real data for Jul–Sep 2025, fallback: 
# create synthetic months with last known attributes
if(nrow(future_df) == 0){
  future_df <- train_df %>%
    sample_n(200) %>%  # use 200 random past flats
    mutate(month = sample(seq(ym("2025-07"), ym("2025-09"), by = "months"), n(), replace = TRUE))
}
```
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#-------------------------------------------------
# 7. Predict
#-------------------------------------------------
future_df$predicted_price <- predict(rf_model, newdata = future_df)

# Save to csv
write_csv(future_df, "predicted_resale_prices_Jul_Sep_2025.csv")
cat("Predictions saved to predicted_resale_prices_Jul_Sep_2025.csv\n")
```
